Hi Rishi / Camila —

Thanks again for carving out time this morning. Quick recap from SkyLake's side and a proposed next step so we don’t lose momentum:

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use case: enterprise customers that require private deploy (VPC/on-prem) via marketplace listing + automated provisioning.
- Constraints: SOC 2 evidence, KMS integration for keys, and a predictable procurement path for Dedicated capacity.
- Success criteria on the partner side: 1) clear provisioning flow for customer via cloud marketplace, 2) documented network/KMS reqs, 3) a short demo the infra teams can validate against.

Proposed next step:
- 60-minute technical alignment + demo led by Redwood solutions engineering
- Goal: confirm manifest/marketplace artifacts, network topology options (VPC peering vs. private link), and an initial runbook for procurement handoff.

Two windows that work for our engineering and marketplace PMs:
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Aug 11, 08:00–09:00 PT

Calendly link to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/priya-sgl/60min
I’m attaching a short partner brief so your team can share with solutions engineering ahead of the call.

Attachments: SkyLake_Redwood_Intro.pdf (partner brief)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

— Priya Singh

- Can you confirm which SkyLake attendees will join from engineering / marketplace PM? Alex Chen from Cloudfold was mentioned — happy to have them in the session.
- Please share any marketplace manifest examples and network egress IP ranges ahead of the call. Our SEs prefer to have a one-page checklist to validate during the demo — I’m attaching a redwood-technical-checklist.docx that outlines what we’ll ask for.
- Success criteria we’ll use on our side: demo completes provisioning end-to-end, no blocker in KMS/auth flow, and a clear timeline for marketplace listing approval.
